# Patent and licensing profiles

**Draft for a lawyer's review. This document is not legal advice and states no legal conclusion.** It is generated by
`scripts/gen-patent-profiles.py` from `profiles/*.json` (the same files that generate the FFmpeg build flags), so it lists
exactly what is compiled into each profile. Strategy and sources: `docs/RESEARCH.md` section 3.

## Who is responsible

- The engine is built on FFmpeg under the LGPL (a copyright licence). **Patents are separate and local to a country.** Neither
  FFmpeg nor this package grants patent licences. **The integrator (the app publisher) is responsible for the patent licences
  of every profile and codec it enables and distributes**, in every territory where the app is available.
- A profile is a separate binary variant (`FFmpegLGPL.xcframework` is `core`, `FFmpegLGPL-extended.xcframework` is
  `core` + `extended`). An app that links only `core` contains none of the software decoders listed under `extended` and
  `licensedAudio`. `MediaInfo.requiredProfile` tells the host which profile a file needs, so it can gate the feature.
- The engine never decides what is allowed: the host app does.

## Launch default

1. **Apple's decoders decode** whatever they cover (H.264, HEVC, AAC, AC-3, E-AC-3, ALAC, MP3, ProRes, hardware AV1 where the
   chip has it). The remux path only repackages bytes and converts lossless audio.
2. **Our own decoders only for royalty-free or expired codecs** (the `extended` profile; statuses below).
3. **Container work needs no codec licence** (reading and remuxing Matroska, AVI, FLV, RealMedia, MPEG-TS and so on); the
   containers of old formats are still reported as needing `extended` so a host can offer them as a paid feature.
4. **Off by default and not built:** VC-1 and WMV3 (held back until cleared), DTS, DTS-HD and Dolby TrueHD (`licensedAudio`,
   not part of the shipped binaries), Dolby Vision profile 7 conversion, a software H.264 decoder (so no Hi10P), Windows Media
   Audio and RealAudio (the decoders are left out of version 1).
5. A module is switched on only after a lawyer's opinion and once there is revenue to pay a licensor who asks.

## Trademarks

Do not use Dolby, Dolby Vision, Dolby Atmos, DTS, DTS-HD, TrueHD, Apple, AirPlay or FFmpeg marks or logos as branding of your
app or of this package. Plain descriptive mentions ("plays files with Dolby Digital audio") need review by a lawyer. The text
required by the licences is in `third_party/NOTICES.md` and `MediaEngine.acknowledgements`.

## Status vocabulary

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `apple-decoder` | no software decoder in our binary; the system decodes it under Apple's licences |
| `royalty-free` | published as royalty-free by its owner; patent-pool claims by third parties have been reported (see the note) |
| `expired` | the patents are reported to have expired (sources in `docs/RESEARCH.md`; to be confirmed by the lawyer) |
| `open`, `no-patents` | open formats and old formats without known live claims |
| `apple-licensed` | encoding done by Apple's AudioToolbox |
| `needs-review` | the status is not established; the decoder is in the profile and is a candidate for removal |
| `needs-clearance` | live licensing programmes; the decoder is **not** in any shipped binary |
| `container` | a container or demuxer: no codec licence; grouped with `extended` for gating only |

## Profile `core`

Demuxing, remuxing, probing, royalty-free or expired audio, subtitle decoding. No software decoders for patent-pooled video or audio codecs: Apple's decoders play H.264, HEVC, AAC, AC-3 and E-AC-3.

| Codec or format | Status | In this profile's binary | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| aac | apple-decoder | no (not compiled in) | no software decoder shipped; AVPlayer decodes. |
| aac_at | apple-licensed | yes | encoding done by Apple's AudioToolbox (not used by the remuxer yet) |
| ac3 | apple-decoder | no (not compiled in) | no software decoder shipped; AVPlayer decodes. |
| alac | open | yes | Apple open-sourced under Apache-2.0 |
| alac_enc | open | no (not compiled in) | native ALAC encoder; Apple released ALAC under Apache-2.0 with a patent grant |
| eac3 | apple-decoder | no (not compiled in) | no software decoder shipped; AVPlayer decodes. |
| flac | royalty-free | yes | open format |
| h264 | apple-decoder | no (not compiled in) | no software decoder shipped; AVPlayer decodes. Parser only. |
| hevc | apple-decoder | no (not compiled in) | no software decoder shipped; AVPlayer decodes. Parser only. |
| mp3 | expired | yes | patents reported expired in 2017 |
| opus | royalty-free | yes | open format; pool claims reported, see RESEARCH.md |
| pcm | no-patents | yes |  |
| subtitles | n/a | yes | text and bitmap subtitle decoders |
| vorbis | royalty-free | yes | open format |

FFmpeg decoders compiled in: flac, vorbis, opus, mp3float, alac, pcm_s16le, pcm_s16be, pcm_s24le, pcm_s24be, pcm_s32le, pcm_s32be, pcm_f32le, pcm_f32be, pcm_u8, pcm_bluray, pcm_dvd, subrip, ass, ssa, webvtt, mov_text, dvdsub, pgssub, dvbsub.

Other components: demuxers: matroska, mov, mpegts, mpegps, avi, asf, flv, ogg, wav, flac, mp3, aac, ac3, eac3, truehd, dts, srt, ass, webvtt, mpegvideo; muxers: mp4, mov, webvtt, null; encoders: alac, aac_at, webvtt, mov_text.

## Profile `extended`

Adds the RealMedia demuxer and software decoders for codecs Apple does not decode (MPEG-1/2/4, H.263 and Flash video, WMV, RealVideo, VP6/VP8/VP9, Theora) and AV1 through dav1d. H.264 is never software-decoded: Hi10P is out of scope. VC-1 stays off until legal clearance (D-E8). The core binary already demuxes AVI, FLV, ASF and Ogg (container work needs no codec licence), but the plan reports those containers as needing this module (ANM-8: the Pro formats), so a host gates them like the codecs. Shipped as a variant binary (RESEARCH.md section 24, decision D-E11).

| Codec or format | Status | In this profile's binary | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| adpcm | no-patents | yes | MS ADPCM and IMA ADPCM in WAV/AVI; old, no known live claims |
| asf | container | no (not compiled in) | demuxer is in core; the plan reports the container as needing the extended module so a host can gate it (ANM-8) |
| av1 | royalty-free | yes | AOMedia royalty-free patent licence; only used when the device has no AV1 hardware decoder |
| avi | container | no (not compiled in) | demuxer is in core; the plan reports the container as needing the extended module so a host can gate it (ANM-8) |
| cook | needs-review | no (not compiled in) | RealAudio Cook, RA 1.4k/2.8k: not built in version 1 for the same reason as WMA, and status unverified |
| flv | container | yes | demuxer is in core; the plan reports the container as needing the extended module so a host can gate it (ANM-8) |
| h263 | expired | yes | H.263 and Sorenson Spark (FLV1); patents reported expired, confirm in LIC-6 review |
| mp2 | expired | yes | MPEG-1 Audio Layer II (MP2): the patents ran out with those of MP3 and MPEG-1; confirm in the LIC-6 review |
| mpeg1video | expired | yes | MPEG-1 video; all patents expired |
| mpeg2video | expired | yes | last US patent expired 2018-02-13 |
| mpeg4 | expired | yes | MPEG-4 Part 2 (Xvid/DivX); last patent reportedly expired 2026-07 (single source) |
| msmpeg4 | needs-review | yes | Microsoft-era codec; check before enabling |
| rm | container | no (not compiled in) | RealMedia demuxer (extended only); the plan reports the container as needing the extended module (ANM-8) |
| rv | needs-review | yes | RealVideo 1.0-4.0 (RMVB); RealNetworks codecs, status unverified, check before enabling |
| theora | royalty-free | yes |  |
| vp6 | needs-review | yes | On2 VP6 (FLV); not a committed royalty-free codec, check before enabling |
| vp8 | royalty-free | yes | pool claims reported |
| vp9 | royalty-free | yes | pool claims reported |
| wma | needs-review | no (not compiled in) | WMA is not built in version 1: the engine converts audio segment by segment, and WMA's frames reach across packets, which needs a different alignment (deferred, see docs/PROGRESS.md); the decoder is left out |
| wmv | needs-review | yes | WMV1/2; check before enabling |

FFmpeg decoders compiled in: mpeg1video, mpeg2video, mpeg4, msmpeg4v1, msmpeg4v2, msmpeg4v3, wmv1, wmv2, h263, h263i, h263p, flv, vp6, vp6f, rv10, rv20, rv30, rv40, vp8, vp9, theora, mp2float, adpcm_ms, adpcm_ima_wav, libdav1d.

Other components: demuxers: rm.

## Profile `licensedAudio`

DTS, DTS-HD and Dolby TrueHD decoders. Live third-party licensing programs; off by default until a lawyer clears them (D-E8, PlayerApp D-12).

| Codec or format | Status | In this profile's binary | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| dca | needs-clearance | yes | DTS family; licensing program active, expiry status unverified |
| mlp | needs-clearance | yes | Meridian Lossless Packing, basis of TrueHD |
| truehd | needs-clearance | yes | Dolby TrueHD; licensing program active, expiry status unverified |

FFmpeg decoders compiled in: dca, truehd, mlp.

## Third-party libraries and their licences

See `third_party/NOTICES.md` (generated into `MediaEngine.acknowledgements`): FFmpeg LGPL-2.1-or-later (dynamic), dav1d BSD-2-Clause (extended variant), libass ISC, FreeType FTL (a credit line is required), HarfBuzz MIT, FriBidi LGPL-2.1-or-later (dynamic, replaceable). No GPL or non-free component is linked; `scripts/check-licenses.sh` fails the build if one appears.
